headline: Executive order aimed at strengthening the US nuclear energy industry, including the businesses and supply chains behind it.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs the federal government to take steps to support and rebuild the country's nuclear industrial base. That likely means the companies, materials, and workers needed to build and fuel nuclear power plants. No official summary was provided, so the specific actions, agencies, and targets are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They may see new federal actions meant to support nuclear fuel, equipment, and plant construction.
Agencies such as the Department of Energy may be directed to carry out new nuclear-related tasks.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 23, 2025; specific deadlines are not stated in the available information.
